name: The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan
summary: Royal Historian Archesonus asks you to recover information from Thaurissan Relics in the Burning Steppes. What they hold is sought from the Ruins of Thaurissan.

sections.title: Relics in the Ruins
sections.body: The Burning Steppes hold the Ruins of Thaurissan, where Thaurissan Relics contain information Royal Historian Archesonus seeks. You are asked to recover that information and return to him.

faq.q: Who is asking me to go to the ruins?
faq.answer: Royal Historian Archesonus asks you to recover information from Thaurissan Relics.
The Thaurissan Relics are in the Ruins of Thaurissan in the Burning Steppes.
You are asked to recover information from the Thaurissan Relics.
Return to Royal Historian Archesonus after recovering the information.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan
